user.title: Set up RTL-SDR
user.description: Choose how HASDR should access your RTL-SDR hardware.

menu_option_descriptions.local: Use receivers attached to this Home Assistant system. HASDR manages the required SDR runtime automatically on supported Home Assistant installations.
menu_option_descriptions.remote: Connect to a HASDR Engine running on another machine. Host, port, and API token settings are only needed for this advanced mode.

local.title: Local RTL-SDR hardware
local.description: HASDR will use the {backend}. No bridge address, port, or API token needs to be configured manually.

remote.title: Remote HASDR host
remote.description: Advanced mode for an SDR Engine running on another machine.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the remote HASDR Engine.
data_description.port: TCP port used by the remote HASDR Engine. The default is 8099.
data_description.token: Bearer token configured on the remote HASDR Engine.
data_description.use_ssl: Enable only when the remote HASDR Engine is behind a TLS reverse proxy.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the remote HASDR Engine.
error.invalid_auth: The remote HASDR Engine rejected the API token.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while connecting to the HASDR Engine.
error.engine_install_failed: Home Assistant could not install or start the managed HASDR SDR Engine.
error.local_runtime_unavailable: HASDR could not prepare the local RTL-SDR runtime. Check the Home Assistant log for the exact signed-package or hardware-access error.
error.cannot_start_local: The embedded HASDR runtime could not start.
error.usb_access_unavailable: Home Assistant cannot access the USB bus. Map /dev/bus/usb into the Home Assistant container, restart Home Assistant, and try again.

abort.already_configured: This RTL-SDR backend is already configured.
